title: Synthetic example: missing boundary rule when PRD says values must be unique per account

expected.content: Each account can create at most one active rule with the same rule_code. Duplicate active rule_code values must be rejected.

actual.content: The requirement was summarized as generic rule creation and did not extract the uniqueness constraint.

lesson: When a PRD says a value is unique within a business scope, extract it as an explicit validation rule with scope and rejection behavior.
